entities.name: YjfY (query sequence)
observations: 91 aa protein with an N-terminal hydrophobic export signal: MFSRVLALLAVLLLSANTWAA.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Escherichia coli YjfY proteins P0AF86, P0AF87, and P0AF88.
Reference UniProt annotations place YjfY in the periplasm.
Pfam scan identifies a YdgH_BhsA-like domain (PF07338.19) at residues 35–91.
Predicted molecular weight is 10,149 Da and theoretical pI is 5.09.
Functional characterization remains limited; one reference annotation associates YjfY with response to stress.

entities.name: Bacterial periplasm
observations: The query protein is annotated to the periplasm in exact-sequence-match reviewed Escherichia coli YjfY entries.
The N-terminal signal peptide is consistent with Sec-dependent export across the inner membrane; the mature protein is expected outside the cytoplasm, in the periplasm.
No transmembrane region beyond the N-terminal export signal is indicated by the reported evidence.

entities.name: YdgH_BhsA-like family
observations: The query contains a YdgH_BhsA-like Pfam domain, PF07338.19, spanning residues 35–91.
This family/domain supports a small bacterial envelope-associated protein classification, but does not by itself establish a specific biochemical activity.
